name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: ❓ Settings › Help & support: report a problem (with screenshots and what you were doing), ask a question, or read the FAQ.
🚩 Something wrong in the bee yard? Say "report a problem" or "mark that", keep working, and send the report when you're done.
🧪 While we are testing, the app keeps a record of what you tap (not what you type) to help fix problems. It stays on your phone unless you send a report.

🐝 The hive picture is drawn from the back, shows your bottom board, and opens bigger when you tap it. New bottom board choice: screened with a sticky board, and you can change it right in an inspection.
